title: SINGER TREADLE BASE SEWING MAC...
reason: Complete Singer treadle table with an Art Deco decal head that may be a 201 class; retail about $120 to $250.
findings: Three photos (front view, angled view, close-up of the head). Supports the title: complete cast-iron treadle base with treadle wheel, foot plate and a timber table with drawers and a folding side leaf, carrying a black Singer machine head. Marks read after enlarging: gilt SINGER on the arm between small geometric Art Deco style ornaments; SINGER cast in the iron stretcher; the foot plate has cast lettering that is only partly legible. The gold pillar medallion is worn and unreadable. No model plate or serial number is visible, so the model cannot be confirmed. The geometric arm decal, hammered nickel faceplate, spoked chrome handwheel and a motor housing fitted behind the arm all fit an electrified Singer 201 family head (ISMACS lists this decal on the 201, 201-2 and 201K), but that is an inference only. No drive belt is visible, which fits the 'no cord' note.
condition: Used and dirty. Black enamel on the arm and bed is dull and rubbed with speckled loss, decals mostly present but worn, bed plate worn through in the middle. Iron base has surface rust and age but looks complete, table top looks sound. No cord (per title) and no foot controller or belt visible. Not tested.
rescore_note: Complete Singer cast-iron treadle base and timber table with a black Singer head whose deco arm decal and fittings fit a 201 family machine, but that is inference only (no model plate or serial seen); dirty, worn bed plate, no cord, controller or belt and untested, so the 201 upside is discounted to the mid band.
